records.text: Owens said she feels Kimberly Guilfoyle is being made a patsy and alleged that her ambassadorship to Greece was intended to put her far from Donald Trump Jr. and his new relationship.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Anyway, moving on from that, I did want to get to Kimberly Guilfoyle because she's been making the news. People are concerned that she has a MAGA burn book. And I do feel like she is being made the Patsy of the Trump (Donald Trump) administration. What I mean by that. ... is after her and Don Jr. (Donald Trump Jr.) broke up, it was understood that she was given an ambassadorship to Greece because Don Jr. (Donald Trump Jr.) ... wanted her as far as possible, allegedly, from him and his new relationship. Now Kimberly Guilfoyle has been pushed out as the ambassador.
